charts.noPort: A sealed box has no port.

warnings.netVolumeInvalid: The drivers take up more volume than the box. Increase the volume or reduce the driver displacement.
warnings.portVolumeTooLarge: The port doesn't fit in the box at this tuning. Use a narrower port, fewer ports or a larger box.
warnings.portTooShort: The port would have zero or negative length. Use a narrower port or fewer ports.
warnings.portTooLong: The port of this box ({{length}}) has its first pipe resonance at {{pipe}}, inside the band it plays: it leaks out as a peak. Keep it above 3× the low-pass cutoff, with a narrower port or another tuning.
warnings.noInductance: Without Le, the response above a few hundred Hz may look optimistic.
warnings.aboveThermalPower: The power exceeds the driver's thermal rating (Pe).
warnings.rearVolumeInvalid: The volume taken up by the drivers is larger than the rear chamber. Enlarge the rear chamber or reduce the occupied volume.
warnings.portVolumeTooLarge_bandpass: The port does not fit in the front chamber at this tuning. Use a narrower port, fewer ports or a larger front chamber.
warnings.portTooShort_bandpass: The port would have zero or negative length for this front chamber. Use a narrower port or fewer ports.
warnings.portTooLong_bandpass: The port of this front chamber ({{length}}) has its first pipe resonance at {{pipe}}, inside the band it plays: it leaks out as a peak. Keep it above 3× the low-pass cutoff, with a narrower port or another tuning.
warnings.portVolumeTooLarge_rear: The port doesn't fit in the rear chamber at this tuning. Use a narrower port, fewer ports or a larger rear chamber.
warnings.portVolumeTooLarge_front: The port doesn't fit in the front chamber at this tuning. Use a narrower port, fewer ports or a larger front chamber.
warnings.portTooShort_rear: The port would have zero or negative length for this rear chamber. Use a narrower port or fewer ports.
warnings.portTooShort_front: The port would have zero or negative length for this front chamber. Use a narrower port or fewer ports.
warnings.portTooLong_rear: The port of this rear chamber ({{length}}) has its first pipe resonance at {{pipe}}, inside the band it plays: it leaks out as a peak. Keep it above 3× the low-pass cutoff, with a narrower port or another tuning.
warnings.portTooLong_front: The port of this front chamber ({{length}}) has its first pipe resonance at {{pipe}}, inside the band it plays: it leaks out as a peak. Keep it above 3× the low-pass cutoff, with a narrower port or another tuning.

status.fs: {{deviation}} off between Fs, Mms, Vas and Sd (Fs = 1 / 2π√(Mms·Cms)).

alignments.grossNote: The volume already includes what the drivers and ports take up.
alignments.closedQtsTooHigh: With Qts {{qts}} a sealed Butterworth box would exceed 3.3·Vas. Use a higher Qtc or an infinite baffle.
alignments.ventedQtsTooHigh: Qts {{qts}} is high for a vented box: the alignment would ripple by more than 1 dB. Prefer a sealed box.
alignments.qtsTooLow: Qts {{qts}} is low for the vented alignments (below 0.2): the box would be small and the response too high for a subwoofer.
alignments.portTooLarge: The port you entered (total area {{area}}) is too large for this box: to tune to {{fb}} it would take up more volume than the air left inside. Use ports with a total area of up to {{max}}, with a smaller diameter or fewer ports.
alignments.vented: Vented {{name}} for Ql {{ql}}: Vb {{vb}} and Fb {{fb}}. The Keele approximation, used by some calculators, would give {{keeleVb}} and {{keeleFb}}.
